title: Bollinger band
intent: Show Apple's twenty-day trailing closing-price mean with a two-standard-deviation volatility band from the original AAPL rows.

ai.create: Create a responsive UTC Bollinger chart from the AAPL dataset's original Date and Close fields using a twenty-day strict trailing window and bands two sample deviations from the mean.
ai.maintain: Change the window or deviation multiplier while preserving Plot's native compound mark semantics, explicit TanStack interval rows, and the original stock fields.
